lede: Straight numbers, no "it depends." Here is what branding actually costs across the market, and what it costs with us.

range.intro: Branding is priced all over the map. Here is the honest spread:
range.average: The average US company spends about $7,500 on branding. Most of that pays for overhead, account managers and juniors billed as experts, not the thinking.
range.why: What moves the number is simple: how much strategy the work needs, how many deliverables you want, and who actually does the work. A logo is cheap. A brand that shortens your sales cycle is a different purchase.

faq.q: How much should a small business spend on branding?
faq.a: Enough to be chosen, not so much that you feel it for a year. Most small businesses land between a few hundred and a few thousand dollars, the range our work sits in. Spend it on the thinking and the taste, not the office overhead.

faq.q: Why is OOVERT so much cheaper than a typical agency?
faq.a: Senior people, no overhead, no account managers, no juniors billed as experts. You pay for the work and the taste, not the office. The thinking is the same one a network agency would charge ten times for.

faq.q: What is included in the price?
faq.a: Every package lists its scope in full before you buy. Depending on the tier: strategy, positioning, logo, type, colour, voice, guidelines and every source file. No surprise line items, no licensing games. The brand and its files are yours on final payment.

faq.q: Do you offer monthly or payment options?
faq.a: Yes. Alongside fixed-scope projects we run monthly retainers, design on tap, pause or cancel anytime, and embedded staffing for teams that need senior hands full-time. Pick the shape that fits how you work.

Cheaper overhead is not cheaper work. What makes branding bad is juniors, templates and no strategy, not the invoice. Ours is senior-only and strategy-led, and the money-back guarantee stands behind every project.

faq.q: What if I am not happy with the work?
faq.a: We keep going until you are, or we refund you. That is the whole guarantee, and it applies to every tier.

closing.line: Tell us the budget. We will tell you the truth.
closing.note: Send us the project and roughly what you plan to invest. We will tell you honestly what it takes, and whether we are the right studio for it.
